prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1216; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center here in Houston. I had just pulled into a space near the main entrance and was backing out to leave.

Q: What happened as you were backing out?

A: A vehicle came down the aisle behind me and I didn't see it until it was right there. It struck the rear corner of my car on the driver's side.

Q: How fast would you estimate the other vehicle was going?

A: It wasn't going fast, maybe walking speed, but it was moving with some momentum. I felt a solid jolt.

Q: Did you stop your vehicle immediately after the impact?

A: Yes, I stopped right away. The other driver got out and came over, and we exchanged information.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or the emergency room after the collision?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. My neck and lower back were sore and stiff.

Q: What injuries were you diagnosed with?

A: The doctor said I had a neck strain and a lower back strain. They gave me muscle relaxers and told me to do physical therapy.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?

A: Yes, I'm going to physical therapy twice a week. I still have some stiffness when I turn my head and I can't sit for long periods without my back aching.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I missed a couple of days and I've been working shorter shifts since then. My job involves a lot of lifting, so that's been difficult.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered it. I just want to get better and get this resolved.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
